title: chore(utils): move utils to their own files
body:
This rather big PR moves utility functions to their own files. This is handy to migrate the utils progressively to TypeScript. This way we can type the ones that we use for new features only, and not the whole file.

I migrated the very basic ones at the same time.

In the future we can also create a test file for each.

[See the `utils/` folder →](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/39f675a6a1ac5b0ef4e5d0c3d65b846a0c2598df/src/lib/utils)
